notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/b5e2b8658969223913812b05ce4610940dc3bf71.png
Hey guys!

We're finally here with the long-awaited Spring Update!

This update brings a bunch of new CGs created by Animetix, the lovely studio that created the opening animation.

We have also been working on a unique new feature for the game, but unfortunately it couldn't make it into this update. (though please look forward to it!)

Hopefully, these beautiful new CGs will make up for it! (If you've already played the game, they should already be unlocked in the gallery)

Here's a short list compiling what's new in this update:


 Added MULTIPLE new CGs
 Gallery now includes new CGs
 Updated credits
 Fixed some typos and grammar issues


If you have feedback or bugs that you'd like to let us know about, OR want to meet more yuri fans, you can join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/aVxXJZSWny

Thank you guys for continuing to support us! <3

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/a614a1d9e6b83785aaef57094ea23efc377c1724.png
Hey guys!

We've been working on a lot of stuff, but wanted to release some updates now so that you guys can experience them!

Here's a list of the additions and changes that will be in this update:


 Added new CGs and backgrounds
 Gallery now includes new CGs, and you can also view acquired BGs
 Added achievements
 Released an original soundtrack available for purchase on the Steam store page
 Updated credits
 GUI update


We plan to have a major update for the Visual Novel festival in March 2025 as well, so please stay tuned!

If you have feedback or bugs that you'd like to let us know about, you can join our discord here: https://discord.gg/aVxXJZSWny

Thank you guys for continuing to support us <3

notes.title: Thank You! + Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/049fec6473c674b9d988dc8679e82bcc793cccee.png

Hey guys!

Thank you so much for your support so far. It makes all of these sleepless nights worth it for us in the end. We still have a lot of work to do though!

We've been reading all of your comments and reviews on our game! We'd like to hear feedback on what you guys would have liked to see more of.

There's still a lot of things we'd like to polish and change, and we were thinking about ways to increase the immersion in certain key scenes in the game.

In the coming weeks, here's what we have planned:

 UI improvements
 BGM and audio adjustments
 Achievements
 An original soundtrack release
 New BG images

In the meantime, you remember those guys that got their hands blown off by Sofia in the opening trailer? Here's the concept art for them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/688af78b17fd14ceafb7bf24b07de36960aef262.png

We hope to continue to have your support in the future!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/8ed8e5950a2ace906f763374534f90ccd18ea597.png

Hey everyone!

As announced before, today's update will add some exciting things to the demo!

This update will include:

 Voice acting for EVERY SINGLE CHARACTER (in English)!!
 New sprite additions for Iulian Dascalu, Garridan Răzvan Zugrăvescu, Agata Agapov, Mihai Stanislav, and Lord Stanislav.
 Minor grammar fixes
 More SFX added
 Slight adjustments to some sentences that were phrased a bit oddly
 Text Localizations in Japanese, simplified/traditional Chinese, and Spanish
 Talking and blinking animations for all sprites
 Volume normalization for all sounds


We hope you guys enjoy it!

notes.title: Upcoming Update & News
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/1ba70da913ba649ee5a7f8b8284b9e839c16cfa9.png

Hey everyone! Apologies for the recent bout of inactivity in our social media! We've been working on some big things behind the scenes.

We're so excited to let you guys know that the demo for Scarlet Defiance: The Wall Between Us is going to receive a major update soon within the month of September, which includes all of the following:


 Every character is now voiced (in English)
 New sprite additions
 Minor grammar fixes
 More SFX
 Slight adjustments to some sentences that were phrased a bit oddly
 Localizations in JP, CN, and ES


Additionally, we have a huge announcement to make! We'll be attending Tokyo Game Show (9/26 - 9/29) as well to spread the word overseas. We'll be holding a raffle at the end of each day to win an exclusive prize for attendees, as well as showcasing the newest version of our demo!

For anyone coming, we hope to see you there! Thank you for all the support so far!
